rules.title: Rent Control coverage under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to fully covered units: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. New construction, newer single-family tenancies, most condominiums, certain subsidized units and exempt units are not under rent control.
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered (rent control applies): most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996; rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases). Includes units with Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8), Shelter Plus Care, VASH Voucher, LIHTC, California Community Housing Agency, HOME, City of Berkeley Housing Trust Fund, Mental Health Safety Act subsidies, and Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, Project-based Section 8 subsidies if the project does not have a mortgage insured or held by HUD.
rules.exemptions: No rent control for: new construction units built and receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996; most condominiums; units with Section 202 or Section 811 subsidies; units with Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, Project-based Section 8 subsidies in a project with a HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage. Fully exempt: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied); units where owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and lived on property when tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley’s Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

rules.title: Just Cause for Eviction coverage under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction protections apply to both fully and partially covered units, including new construction, single-family homes, most condominiums and certain subsidized units; only exempt units are excluded.
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered and partially covered units: multifamily units built before 1980, new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes regardless of tenancy start, rooming houses, most condominiums, and units with listed government subsidies.
rules.exemptions: Exempt: Golden Duplex (duplex owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently with an owner living in one unit); unit where owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley’s Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most condominiums** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
